description: This file contains utility functions for metrics collection and reporting in the Android Open Source Project, including system info retrieval, hashing, session ID generation, and HTTP request handling for metrics submission.

methods.name: Hashing
methods.description: Generates a hash string from input string using std::hash.

methods.name: GetOsName
methods.description: Retrieves the operating system name using uname.

methods.name: GenerateSessionId
methods.description: Creates a session ID based on current time and MAC address.

methods.name: GetCfVersion
methods.description: Returns the CF version, currently empty.

methods.name: GetOsVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the OS version using uname.

methods.name: GetMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the primary network interface.

methods.name: GetCompany
methods.description: Returns the company name, hardcoded as 'GOOGLE'.

methods.name: GetVmmVersion
methods.description: Returns the VMM version, currently empty.

methods.name: GetEpochTimeMs
methods.description: Returns current epoch time in milliseconds.

methods.name: curl_out_writer
methods.description: Callback for writing curl response data, discards data.

methods.name: SetCurlUrlPart
methods.description: Sets a part of a CURLU URL object.

methods.name: ClearcutServerUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL string for different Clearcut server environments.

methods.name: PostRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to send metrics data to the specified server.
